name: sn64-miner-bot-serve
dockerStartCmd: set -eu; command -v git >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git; }; if [ -d /workspace/sn64-miner-bot/.git ]; then git -C /workspace/sn64-miner-bot pull --ff-only; else git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_URL" /workspace/sn64-miner-bot; fi; exec bash /workspace/sn64-miner-bot/scripts/runpod_serve.sh
